title: Reusable grouped results: exact proof fixtures
purpose: Reviewable input data and exact expected mathematical results for the proposed reusable-query-output design.

checkBoundary.executable: verify-proof-fixtures.py checks the supplied data, arithmetic, typed grouping, occurrence multiplicity, and expected empty-population contract with Python standard-library arithmetic.
checkBoundary.notExecutableHere: No explorEDA evaluator, parser, worker, persistence, React, notebook, or browser test is executed by this oracle. Those acceptance cases remain proposed.
checkBoundary.numericPolicy: For these fixtures, finite numbers and finite decimal-number text are eligible; null, blank text, nonnumeric text, booleans, and nonfinite text are excluded. Production code must reuse lib/valueParsing.ts.
checkBoundary.countPolicy: count(*) counts input occurrences; count(field) counts non-null/non-undefined values, including invalid text and blanks; numericCount counts the exact eligible inputs of a numeric measure.
checkBoundary.unavailableEncoding: JSON null in expected statistics means unavailable, corresponding to undefined numeric results in the evaluator. An observed zero is the string '0', never null.
checkBoundary.rationalEncoding: Exact expected numeric statistics are strings, such as '25' or '40/3'. The oracle uses Fraction and does not compare rounded floating-point output.
checkBoundary.nonfiniteInputEncoding: The raw nonfinite input is the JSON-safe string 'Infinity'.
checkBoundary.occurrencePolicy: Array entries are source occurrences. Equal values and duplicate measurement IDs do not collapse entries. Durable row identity across refresh is outside this oracle.

primary.description: One result row per observed experiment ID; unequal numeric sample sizes and an all-ineligible group.

resultFilter.description: Filter the result rows by mean >= 20. This is not a producer input filter.

sourceRefresh.description: Replace B's measurement b3 value 60 with 90 in a new source revision.

producerInputFilter.description: Explicitly retain numeric measurements <= 20 before grouping. Groups with no retained occurrences disappear.

duplicateSourceIds.description: Change a2's measurement ID to a1. The two physical occurrences remain distinct and neither is dropped.

typedKeysAndEqualReadings.description: Numeric 1 and text '1' are different group keys. Independent equal readings are separate occurrences.

emptyPopulation.description: An empty input and an input filtered to zero rows have the same ready-empty mathematics. A missing source is a different proposed blocked state.

overlapCounterexample.description: A provenance-only counterexample, not a second product workflow. The same source occurrence m2 is reached by two immediate result rows; leaf-set union cannot substitute for immediate membership or weighted occurrence count.

orderCategoryMembership.description: A constrained second workflow: orders represented in product categories. An order spanning two categories is a member of both groups. Summing the grouped counts or amounts measures order-category membership, not unique original orders.

proposedApplicationAcceptance.case: Two consumers reference the same producer definition and reflect its definition/source updates. Memoization is limited to an evaluation context; separate mounted views have no global once-only computation guarantee.
A self reference and a two-query cycle fail with a named dependency path.
Missing source, removed producer, and removed required producer field block the affected consumer rather than fabricating an empty successful result.
Late completion of evaluation N cannot replace completed evaluation N+1; pending rows and traces use one complete previous snapshot.
An output filter or contributor highlight never becomes an upstream producer-input predicate.

Saved reference IDs and explicit bindings round trip through portable project files, project text, local folders, and notebook compilation. Selected-view export retains transitive producer definitions, sources, relationships, selected-view binding definitions, and parameter-option sources; reopened summary remains 25/28.

Existing same-query views with different bindings remain distinct instances. Build 24 phase-prefixed occurrences from PF-01 baseline and PF-03 followup. B1/B2 and C begin at 25/28; changing B's reference to followup makes B1/B2 30/34 while C stays 25/28. A direct producer-view binding edit changes neither reference. A shared pre-group numeric <=20 filter makes both bound instances 15 and 40/3.

Source occurrence keys and immediate result-row addresses remain separately traceable through aggregate-on-aggregate and count measures. Producer/consumer local step-ID collisions cannot redirect imported field traces; physical endpoint origin survives for grouped-key lookups. Numeric aggregate field metadata survives empty/all-missing output.
Pointer and keyboard workflows pass at widths 1280, 783, and 390 pixels, including focus return, visible scope, and bounded editors.
